item.content:encoded: This is a bit rough around the edges, and spends a lot of detail on the specific nature of the anomaly, going a bit too in depth past the point where things are interesting anymore. That being said, the description of the pose and facial expressions of the woman is just enough to give a strong mental image. If it was any longer that moment would wear off, but it's short enough to work. A rewrite could help, but isn't necessary. +1

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Some digging into local legends, paired with descriptions of the tree before the fire and applied botany facts on sandalwood growth could give a reasonably reliable estimate of the minimum age of the statue. Which in turn could imply something about how she got this way.

It's a logical detail to include in-universe, especially since they have so little hard data to write about.

In terms of fiction, it would give the reader a little something more to hang their speculations on. Speculation about what she was running from being the best part of this piece, but some more attachment points for the imagination would not be a bad thing.
